title: Moobloom Variants (Example Pack)
description: This datapack makes it so you can add data driven variants to Belgie's mooblooms mod
body:
Now Updated for 1.21.5!
This datapack is a example pack on how to add your own data-driven variants to Mooblooms within Belgies Forge/Neoforge mooblooms mod [Mod Download](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mooblooms-flowercow) 

To add your own variants you can either watch the tutorial linked above or download the pack and change the json/tags to whatever variant you would like!
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/BPjMEac3xP0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Note: adding new variants dont replace the variants already within the mod, to replace any variant you need to rename the json within the datapack to the moobloom variants flower type

If you find any issues feel free to let us know and enjoy adding your own variants to the moobloom

Here are all options you can currently change within the datapack:
